Epic breakfast and really good Dinner buffet: read details here!
Mar 2023 • Friends
Believe all the reviews that rave about Pullman’s breakfast buffet. The chefs at Epice are highly skilled (superb breakfast buffet). The service and operations at Epice are equally commendable: efficient, genuinely caring and friendly staff, well-placed signage and buffet plating.

Overall, really enjoyed the breakfast buffet - it’s one of the best hotel breakfasts (if not the best) I’ve ever had. 

- Vietnamese food selection: even better than the most popular street food especially the Ban Xeo pancakes, and noodles. Selection changes every day so you get to try many important Vietnamese dishes at a quality that is even better than the most popular/best street food outlets recommended by Da Nang locals. 

- Pastries: top notch, especially the bread and butter pudding and mango Danish. 

- Cooked selection: a good range of Asian food – the Indian food in particular was really good. The sausages are the real thing, a rarity at hotel buffets.

Dinner buffet: The Saturday dinner buffet was very good. 

Dinner at Pullman’s other restaurant – the beach-front Azure- was also very good (Pullman has really good chefs) – you can read my other reviews about the hotel and Azure if you’d like to learn more.

Very good breakfast and Christmas dinner buffet
Dec 2018 • Family
Stayed in this hotel for 5 days and highly recommend their breakfast there!
Large variety of choice for food even beverages; some highlights here:
from hot/cold coffee to smoothies/ energetic/detox fruit juice or Bloody Mary!) For food, you can choose from fresh make waffle/ pancake(serving with 3choices ice-cream) cold cut like ham/ salami/ cheese to full range of salad/ yogurt bar /3 types of pho 
....etc. 
I would say more like a brunch than a breakfast! We are a family of 3 and we enjoyed it so much!

For the Christmas dinner buffet, the only thing I have to complain about is we checked the price on internet in advance, at the end they quote a more expensive price! When I asked about this it went though 3 guys and the manger came out to tell the website brochure was for 2017....made a big chaos and took me quite long to book the dinner becoz of this.
At the end, the food are quite good and they arranged magic show, kids face painting ,ballon clown( a big credit to the clown as he makes nice ballons! Colourful flowers even reindeer!)slime making class...etc.
